correctness.rationale: Strongest headline claim (DRAFT Thm i-iii): for each of the 24 hyperbolic triples 2<=p<=q<=r<=6 with 1/p+1/q+1/r<1, in the committed two-rotation Fuchsian model of D(p,q,r)=<a,b|a^p=b^q=(ab)^r=1>, enumeration of all reduced words to L=10 yields stated totals (3070 per exactly-one-2 triple, 118097 per p,q>=3 triple), stated trivial/elliptic/hyperbolic counts with zero nontrivial parabolics, and stated in-bound minimal |trace|/translation length l=2arccosh(|tr|/2) with witness word and second-best gap >=0.047; each Euclidean triple has zero hyperbolic words to L=10 with stated counts. Independent from-scratch numpy recomputation of ALL 27 strata reproduced every total, every type count, every minimum value to <1e-9, zero nontrivial parabolics, and gap values; integer-exponent Euclidean replay reproduced all Euclidean counts with zero hyperbolic. Model checks: A^p,B^q,(AB)^r=+-I to 1e-12, generator traces 2cos(pi/p),2cos(pi/q),-2cos(pi/r), det=1, t=(cp*cq+cr)/(sp*sq)>1 for all 24. Tolerance robustness: classification tolerance 1e-9 vs smallest min|tr|-2=0.288 ((2,4,5)) ratio ~3.5e-9; smallest second-best gap 0.047 ((4,5,6)) >> floating noise; exact-form minima (14/24) agree with a+b*sqrt(d) radicals to <1e-12. Minimality is explicitly scoped in-bound (len<=10), not global systole; witness identity is value-invariant (ties admitted, e.g. 24088 minimizers for (3,3,4)), honestly disclosed. Evidence is computational certification by two independent routes (float64 primary + 80-digit replay), correctly distinguished from analytic proof; no general theorem is claimed beyond the bounded census.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp/search: (1) Moreno-Stypa arXiv:1303.0962 proves Cayley/coset vertex-to-edge duality for D(a,b,c) — abstract verified; no matrix models, no word enumeration, no trace table. (2) Zimmermann arXiv:2110.11050 surveys Hurwitz/maximal actions including single (2,3,7) PSL2(7)/Klein-quartic landmark — abstract verified; one extremal group, not a uniform window census with witness words. (3) Singerman BLMS 2.3.319 gives Fuchsian signature/subgroup existence theory — constraints only, no explicit 2x2 embeddings or bounded enumeration. (4) Schein-Shoan arXiv:2012.08796 bounds systolic length of Riemann surfaces uniformized by congruence subgroups of triangle groups via generator traces (upper bounds, logarithmic growth) — different objects (finite-index subgroups/modular curves) and different invariant (global upper bound, not per-triple length<=10 minima with Euclidean contrast). (5) Karrer et al arXiv:1812.08567 shows (2,4,5)/(2,5,5) are not systolic as systolic complexes — combinatorial non-positive curvature, no Fuchsian traces or translation lengths; disambiguates terminology. Individual traces follow from standard embeddings (admitted in DRAFT sec.4), but the uniform per-triple in-bound-minimum table with ranked word logs, full type counts, zero-parabolic finding and Euclidean contrast over the complete entries-bounded-by-6 window is not mechanically implied by, a renaming of, or a parameter substitution of any of these.

value.rationale: Independently worth retrieving as an exact invariant of a natural object under the exact-invariant clause: object = von Dyck groups D(p,q,r) in committed Fuchsian embeddings over the complete entries-bounded-by-6 hyperbolic window (24 triples, verified complete by 1/p+1/q+1/r<1 enumeration) plus the three Euclidean boundary triples — a natural classification boundary fixed before computation, containing the recognized Euclidean-vs-hyperbolic threshold. Invariant = per-triple short-word trace-type census to L=10 (exact word totals, trivial/elliptic/hyperbolic counts, zero-nontrivial-parabolic finding, in-bound minimal |trace|/translation length with witness and separation gap) contrasted against Euclidean zero-hyperbolic distributions — motivated before computation by the Fuchsian trace-spectrum/systole program (Maskit trace identities, Singerman geometry, McMullen length-spectrum questions), values not known or mechanically implied (require enumeration; 10/24 minima have no closed radical), and reasonably needed as precise facts for Fuchsian-software calibration, test cases, and threshold teaching examples. Honestly scoped as in-bound minima, not global systoles; not a textbook restatement, bare failed-search log, arbitrary scope, or unexplained number. The complete 24+3 bounded census is delivered (not an incomplete survey), with limitations stated.

decisive_checks: Recomputed all 24 hyperbolic + 3 Euclidean strata from scratch (numpy + integer-exponent Euclidean model): 27/27 totals, type counts, zero nontrivial parabolics, and all 24 minima values match to <1e-9; gaps >=0.047 reproduced.
Verified model faithfulness for all 24: A^p=B^q=(AB)^r=+-I, generator traces, det=1, t>1; tolerance/margin analysis (1e-9 vs 0.288 margin, gaps >> noise).
Verified window completeness (24 hyperbolic + 3 Euclidean = full 2<=p<=q<=r<=6 partition), table monotonicity in min|tr|, and 14/14 claimed radical exact forms to <1e-12.
Fetched and compared abstracts of the four nearest priors plus Singerman; confirmed disjoint objects/invariants/routes.
residual_risks: 10/24 minima lack proven closed radicals; values are certified numerically by two independent routes with gaps >=0.047 but closed forms remain open (explicitly disclosed, does not affect the certified decimal minima).
Results are model-relative (committed two-rotation Fuchsian embedding) and bound-relative (L=10); global systoles and other embeddings are out of scope (explicitly disclaimed).
Witness words are lex-first representatives among often-large tie classes; only the min|tr|/length value is the invariant (explicitly disclosed).
